text:
[Council File 25-0651]
Verbal update from HR&A Advisors and the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles regarding identifying funding solutions to ensure that families and individuals housed can remain housed; and the feasibility of implementing a local subsidy program that does not rely on Federal funding sources to keep individuals housed.
(Scheduled pursuant to Council action of July 1, 2025)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Verbal update on identifying funding solutions to help families and individuals remain housed and the feasibility of a local subsidy program independent of Federal funding.
